I will grow enset on this small plot near my homestead, as it is the staple that feeds my family throughout the year. I have enough cow manure to spread on this 0.14 hectare, but buying chemical fertilizer from the cooperative is too costly for such a small garden and the supply is unreliable anyway. I will use suckers from my own enset field and do all the planting, mulching, and weeding with my family, since we cannot afford to hire labor.
